name: gptaku-plugins
description: GPTaku plugins for Claude Code - documentation guides and developer tools

plugins.name: docs-guide
plugins.description: Fetch and explain official documentation for any library/framework using llms.txt pattern

plugins.name: git-teacher
plugins.description: Git/GitHub onboarding for non-developers using cloud folder analogy. 5-phase approach with Korean language support.

plugins.name: vibe-sunsang
plugins.description: AI mentor agent for vibe coders - analyzes Claude Code conversations and provides growth coaching with 4 workspace types (Builder/Explorer/Designer/Operator).

plugins.name: insane-research
plugins.description: AI-powered deep research with multi-agent source verification, 7-phase pipeline, and structured report generation.

plugins.name: pumasi
plugins.description: Parallel coding orchestration + Codex image generation — /pumasi for parallel code, /pumasi:image for AI image generation

plugins.name: show-me-the-prd
plugins.description: Draft-first PRD generator — probe the real problem, draft 4 design documents immediately, confirm assumptions in one batch

plugins.name: kkirikkiri
plugins.description: Natural language team builder for Claude Code — one sentence becomes an AI team (Agent Teams) or a deterministic agent pipeline (Workflows). User picks the execution substrate; models are tiered (Opus lead/judge, Sonnet workers, cross-model review via Codex/agy)

plugins.name: skillers-suda
plugins.description: 4 persona Agent Team skill builder — spawn real agents to analyze and debate, then build working skills with auto eval/benchmark, description optimization via run_loop, and .skill packaging

plugins.name: nopal
plugins.description: Google Workspace 9개 서비스를 자연어로 오케스트레이션하는 Claude Code 플러그인 — No Opal needed

plugins.name: insane-search
plugins.description: Platform-specific access strategies for AI agents — adaptively accesses blocked sites (X/Twitter, Reddit, Stack Overflow, Naver, Coupang, LinkedIn) without API keys. Phase 0→3 adaptive scheduler with curl_cffi TLS impersonation and auto dependency install.

plugins.name: insane-design
plugins.description: Design system extractor, applier, and builder — analyze any URL, apply to your project, or build from scratch with deterministic CSS + §18 DON'T grep contract

plugins.name: insane-review
plugins.description: GPT Pro(웹 전용·API 없음 — 최신 플래그십 모델의 Pro 추론)를 Claude Code 안에서 활용 — repomix로 관련 코드만 정밀 패킹 → 구독 ChatGPT Pro에 투입 → 분석/의견 회수. agent-council 웹 전용 멤버로도 통합.

plugins.name: goaljaby
plugins.description: Bridge skill from PRD to /goal for Claude Code — auto-generates 5 Korean review docs (VALIDATION/RECOVERY/PLAN/PROGRESS/goal-command), shows a Korean review summary in chat, prepends a 4-line summary to PROGRESS.md, and after a mandatory human approval gate the assistant emits /goal on the last line of its reply so the session starts the goal on the next turn.

plugins.name: dd
plugins.description: Drop the current clipboard (text or image) into Claude Code with /dd or /ㅇㅇ — no pasting.

plugins.name: gaseo
plugins.description: Register a Claude Code session with Paseo so it shows up in the app and you can continue it there.

plugins.name: tikeytaka
plugins.description: Central API key vault — consolidate scattered .env keys into an encrypted cloud-synced vault, register without chat exposure, auto-wire keys when tasks need them, propagate everywhere
